title: BUILD-017-sports-data-r-d-ingestion
universal_lens: The transition from open-source leverage to proprietary ingestion is modeled as a constrained optimization over a bounded Hilbert space. The operator maps unstructured API documentation into a rigorously isolated sandbox, enforcing strict boundary conditions that prevent leakage into the production manifold while maximizing information extraction efficiency.
gsi_mapping: GSI treats this R&D packet as a conformal prediction set for architectural viability. By isolating the evaluation of Hoppscotch and AnythingLLM in a zero-trust sandbox, we bound the epistemic uncertainty of external dependencies, ensuring that any future integration maintains rigorous probabilistic guarantees without contaminating the core inference engine.
gse_mapping: Within GSE, this primitive defines a discrete state-transition from 'unverified OSS' to 'approved internal SOP'. It enforces a strict topological separation between `docs/research` and `apps/web`, acting as a situational reasoning gate that prevents unauthorized mutations to the production deployment graph.

primitives.name: Bounded Sandbox Isolation Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Security Boundary No secrets, production data, customer PII, proprietary method docs, payment data, or production source keys.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: S: Set of prohibited production artifacts (dimensionless). \Omega_{prod}: Production state space. \Omega_{sandbox}: Isolated R&D state space.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a perfect partition exists between the sandbox environment and the production infrastructure, such that no implicit memory sharing occurs.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down if an environmental variable leak bridges \Omega_{sandbox} and \Omega_{prod}, causing a catastrophic security singularity.

layer2.mapping: Maps directly to the GSE requirement of zero-trust microservices, ensuring R&D activities do not alter the production topology.
layer2.telemetry: Count of accidental references to `.env*` or Stripe keys within the research branch.

primitives.name: Documentation-First State Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: Start in docs or a sandbox and only move into app code after explicit approval.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: t: Discrete time step (integer). A_t: Approval boolean (0 or 1). D_t: Documentation completeness metric (0..1).
primitives.assumptions: Assumes that the documentation phase fully captures the intended system behavior before any executable code is synthesized.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if the approval heuristic A_t is bypassed, leading to unvetted code injection into the main branch.

layer2.mapping: Derives the GSE operational workflow where `docs/ops/` acts as the primary control kernel for all subsequent `apps/` mutations.
layer2.telemetry: Ratio of committed documentation files to application code files prior to merge.

primitives.name: License Compliance Filter
primitives.verbatim_quote: Disallowed: copying source code or UI into GSE, white-labeling restricted projects, or modifying AGPL/MPL/custom-license code without legal approval.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: L: License type (AGPL, MPL, Custom). C: Copy operation (boolean). P: Legal permission flag (boolean).
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a deterministic mapping between license types and permissible modification operations within the GSE ecosystem.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Violated if dual-licensed components are integrated without resolving the most restrictive clause, triggering legal contagion.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to the GSI compliance layer, filtering out high-risk data sources based on their contractual entropy.
layer2.telemetry: Number of flagged files by automated license scanners (e.g., FOSSA) in the PR.
